T0591.title: DID
T0591.definition: A decentralized identifier that enables verifiable, self-managed digital identity without a central registry dependency.
T0591.description: DIDs let subjects manage verifiable identifiers without depending on a centralized registry. They are useful for verifiable credentials, cross-platform identity, and decentralized trust, but require governance for key recovery, identifier resolution, privacy correlation, and ecosystem interoperability.
T0591.usageExample: Assess DID related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
